scene: Sipping warm jasmine tea reveals three departure platforms beyond the arch.
picture: Side-view pixel art along a tiled platform line. Far left sits the carved koi-shaped boat moored at a canal edge. Left of centre, the grandfather in his navy apron holds a steaming teacup while leaning on his plant-laden bicycle. Centre stands a waiting glass tram, and far right an open vine-covered garden tram.
shown: a sleek carved wooden koi boat floating on a water canal far left
a glowing glass tram waiting at an open platform gate in the centre
a vine-draped open-air garden tram idling at a raised track on the far right
